title: UniOTalign: A Global Matching Framework for Protein Alignment via Optimal Transport
key_contribution: Recasts sequence alignment as Fused Unbalanced Gromov-Wasserstein transport; handles nonsequential similarities

title: Auto-weighted Sequential Wasserstein Distance and Application to Sequence Matching
key_contribution: Proposes shape-aware Wasserstein distance for sequences incorporating temporal position, neighborhood structure, and similarity measures

title: REALIGN: Regularized Procedure Alignment with Matching Video Embeddings via Partial Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport
key_contribution: Uses partial Gromov-Wasserstein OT for temporal alignment; handles noise and repeated actions via unbalanced transport
